items.title: S&P Global (SPGI) Closes DatacenterHawk Deal And Energy Software Exit
items.summary: S&P Global (NYSE:SPGI) has completed its acquisition of data center analytics firm datacenterHawk. The company has also finalized the divestiture of its upstream energy software portfolio to Schlumberger. The transactions reshape S&P Global's mix of information and software assets across infrastructure and energy.
